title: FHWA Pavement Maintenance
text: FHWA maintains technical resources covering pavement maintenance topics including pothole repair and procedures for sealing and filling cracks in asphalt-surfaced pavements.

title: FHWA Pavement Preservation Training
source: Federal Highway Administration - Pavement Preservation Training
text: FHWA pavement preservation training covers treatment selection and construction topics such as crack filling and sealing, patching and edge repairs, chip seals, fog seals, slurry seals, microsurfacing, and overlays.

title: FHWA Pavement Preservation Definitions
source: Federal Highway Administration - Pavement Preservation Definitions
text: FHWA describes routine maintenance examples including crack filling and pothole patching, and describes corrective maintenance as work responding to deficiencies that affect safe and efficient facility operation.

title: FHWA Distress Identification Manual
source: Federal Highway Administration - Distress Identification Manual
text: The FHWA Distress Identification Manual documents pavement distress types and provides structured severity and measurement guidance for pavement distresses, including potholes and patch deterioration.

title: FHWA Pavement Preservation Checklist Series
source: Federal Highway Administration - Pavement Preservation Checklist Series
text: FHWA provides pavement preservation checklists covering treatments such as crack seal application, chip seal, thin hot mix asphalt overlay, microsurfacing, patching, joint and crack sealing, and other pavement treatments.
